project.description: Angular CLI project name — only for multi-app workspaces. Defaults to the workspace default project. Unrelated to unwrap scope.

unwrapKey.description: Envelope key passed as provideRiviniaHttp({ unwrapKey }). Asked only in effect when unwrapping is enabled; omit to keep the 'data' default.

x-prompt.message: Backend envelope key (Enter for the 'data' default)?

unwrap.description: Enable envelope unwrapping project-wide. When false, provideRiviniaHttp({ unwrap: false }) is emitted and unwrapKey is ignored.

x-prompt.message: Enable backend envelope unwrapping for this project?
